title: A part sale's single Sales Representative field still saves and logs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A part sale still has a single Sales Representative field, and you give it a representative.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; its Sales Representative field reads "Unassigned".
    For example: {Part-sale-1} is P-30001.
  • Starting screen: {Part-sale-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the part sale's Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the field.
  3. Click {Sales-rep-A} in the dropdown.
  4. Reload the page.
  5. Open the part sale's menu.
  6. Open the log from the menu and read the newest entry.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is one representative field, labelled "Sales representative" with a small "r", and no + button beside it.
  • Step 2: the dropdown opens.
  • Step 3: the field reads {Sales-rep-A}; its label still reads "Sales representative"; still no + and no remove x.
  • Step 4: the field still reads {Sales-rep-A}; the pick was saved.
  • Step 5: the part sale's menu opens.
  • Step 6: the log has an entry for the representative change to {Sales-rep-A}, as Part Sales Update v1 records it.

The part sale's Sales Representative field and its log entry come from Part Sales Update v1 (SV-10266). If that is not on the build being tested, mark this case Blocked and say so.
